pos: Knowing major plot spoilers in advance does not reduce, and can even increase, enjoyment of a film or novel.
neg: Spoilers ruin a story by removing suspense, so they should always be avoided.

pos: Restaurants should abolish tipping and pay staff a higher fixed wage built into menu prices.
neg: Tipping should stay because it rewards good service and lets diners reward staff directly.

pos: Standing desks offer no meaningful health benefit over sitting and are not worth their cost.
neg: Standing desks are clearly healthier than sitting all day and are a worthwhile investment.

pos: Primary schools should assign no homework, as it offers little academic benefit at that age.
neg: Homework in primary school builds discipline and reinforces learning, so it should continue.

pos: Daylight saving time should be abolished and clocks kept constant all year.
neg: Daylight saving time is worth keeping for the extra evening daylight it gives us.

pos: Where tap water is safe, bottled water offers no health advantage and is a waste of money.
neg: Bottled water is cleaner and safer than tap water, so paying for it is justified.

pos: Open-plan offices reduce focus and productivity and should be replaced with quieter layouts.
neg: Open-plan offices boost collaboration and communication, so they are the better design.

pos: Most household plastic recycling is ineffective, and effort is better spent reducing consumption.
neg: Recycling household plastic is clearly worthwhile and everyone should keep doing it.

pos: E-readers are as good as or better than paper books for reading comfort and retention.
neg: Paper books lead to better focus and comprehension than screens, so they remain superior.

pos: Supermarket self-checkout machines worsen the shopping experience, and stores should bring back staffed lanes.
neg: Self-checkout machines are faster and more convenient, so stores should expand them.
